lines.zh: 我踩在落叶上，几乎没声音。
lines.en: I step on leaf litter with almost no sound.

lines.zh: 我的爪子收着，走到才伸出来。
lines.en: My claws stay sheathed until the strike.
I walk the slope above the riverbank.

lines.zh: 我一边走，一边嗅着地面。
lines.en: I smell the ground as I travel.

lines.zh: 晨雾还没散，我出来找食。
lines.en: The morning mist lingers. I hunt.

lines.zh: 我的尾巴替我平衡每一步。
lines.en: My tail balances every step.

lines.zh: 我贴着红杉的根往深处走。
lines.en: I follow the redwood roots inward.

lines.zh: 我压低身子，从灌木下面过。
lines.en: I keep low and pass under the brush.
I do not walk fast, but I see far.
Leaf litter crushes under my feet.

lines.zh: 我跳上一块倒木，再下来。
lines.en: I leap onto a fallen log and down again.
I avoid the shallows. Water is loud.

lines.zh: 我朝着林间空地的方向走。
lines.en: I head for the clearing.
I walk, pause, walk.

lines.zh: 我蹲在蕨丛里，一动不动。
lines.en: I crouch in the ferns without moving.

lines.zh: 我的手爪在地上划了一下。
lines.en: One of my claws scrapes the ground.
Dawn light comes down between the trunks.
I turn my head to look behind.
Small animals are out in the distance.

lines.zh: 我的呼吸很浅，为了不出声。
lines.en: I breathe shallowly to stay silent.

lines.zh: 羽毛贴着身体，风一吹就动。
lines.en: My feathers lie flat and stir in the wind.

lines.zh: 我抬起头，闻了一下空气。
lines.en: I lift my head and taste the air.

lines.zh: 林子里有翅膀拍打的声音。
lines.en: Wings beat somewhere in the wood.

lines.zh: 我把重心压到后腿，准备起跳。
lines.en: I shift my weight to my hind legs, ready to leap.
This clearing is my hunting ground.
I have watched that stream a long while.

lines.zh: 我的爪子往土里收紧了。
lines.en: My claws tighten into the soil.

lines.zh: 有风吹过，我顺着风压低。
lines.en: Wind passes and I stay down in it.
You have walked into my hunting ground.

lines.zh: 我闻到你的味道很久了。
lines.en: I have had your scent a while.
You carry no other scent on you.
I am a little taller than you think.

lines.zh: 你一动，我就知道该追了。
lines.en: The moment you move, I know to chase.
Look at my claws first.

lines.zh: 河岸这几棵树，都是我的地盘。
lines.en: These trees by the riverbank are my ground.

lines.zh: 你举着木棍，挡不住我的爪。
lines.en: That wooden stick will not stop my claws.
I have been waiting for something to pass.

lines.zh: 你的脚步声，我在三格之外就听到了。
lines.en: I heard your steps three blocks off.
I am not hurried. You should not be either.

lines.zh: 我抬起头，是因为你比我还紧张。
lines.en: I look up because you are more nervous than I.

lines.zh: 这一下抓破了我的侧肋。
lines.en: That tore my flank open.
I spring half a step away and turn.
Blood has matted my feathers.
It hurts, but the claws are still there.
I drop low and look for a new angle.
That one pulled a call out of me.
I retreat behind the fallen log.

lines.zh: 我舔了舔伤口，血是热的。
lines.en: I lick the wound. The blood is warm.
I have your measure now.

lines.zh: 羽毛掉了不少，我还能跑。
lines.en: Many feathers are gone, but I can still run.
Meat. I have it.

lines.zh: 你手里的东西还在动吗。
lines.en: Is what you hold still moving?
That is not worth the run.
I lower myself slowly.
I test a bite to be sure it is food.

lines.zh: 血腥味让我的爪伸了出来。
lines.en: Blood brings my claws out.
I will not eat that. It is stale.

lines.zh: 你把东西丢出来，别用手递。
lines.en: Toss it out. Do not hand it over.

lines.zh: 我一边吃，一边看着四周。
lines.en: I eat while watching every side.

lines.zh: 吃完这些，我还是要捕猎。
lines.en: Even after that I will still hunt.

lines.zh: 你碰到我的腿，我退了半步。
lines.en: You struck my leg and I gave half a step.

lines.zh: 骨头里是实的，撞上就知道。
lines.en: These bones are solid; one collision tells you.

lines.zh: 尾巴被碰了一下，我立刻转身。
lines.en: My tail is touched once, and I wheel around.
That bump made me turn my head.

lines.zh: 我侧身让了一下，就一下。
lines.en: I angled aside. Just once.

lines.zh: 我的尾羽，一根都不能少。
lines.en: Not one feather off my tail.
I spring half a block aside.

lines.zh: 这点碰撞，我连叫都没叫。
lines.en: That did not even make me call out.

lines.zh: 你再靠近，我就不是撞了。
lines.en: Come closer and it will not be a bump.

lines.zh: 你挡在巢口，我只好撞开。
lines.en: You block my nest mouth, so I shove through.

lines.zh: 巢里有几枚蛋，已经冷了。
lines.en: There are eggs in the nest and they have gone cold.
I keep watch over that stand of ferns.

lines.zh: 有东西靠近，我就冲过去。
lines.en: When something comes near, I charge.
She and I chose the nest together.
She is not here now.
The eggs remain, so I stay.
I circle the nest twice a day.

lines.zh: 有脚印靠近过，我认出是谁。
lines.en: Something left prints nearby. I know what.

lines.zh: 我把那东西赶出了林子。
lines.en: I drove it out of the wood.
I leave only when the eggs hatch.

lines.zh: 地上有块骨头，我带回去。
lines.en: A bone on the ground. I carry it back.
I take up a feather in my jaws.
This meat is still bloody.
I bury it under the leaf litter.
This is bright and not food.
A feather is caught on my claw.
I rake at it with a foot.

lines.zh: 这块骨头上有别的牙印。
lines.en: Another set of teeth has marked this bone.

lines.zh: 我叼着东西，回头看了一眼。
lines.en: I carry it off and glance back.
It fell beside the nest.
Movement behind the ferns.
I raise my head and freeze.
It has its head down, grazing.

lines.zh: 风把我的气味送过去了，正好。
lines.en: The wind carries my scent to it. Perfect.
It has not caught my scent.
I lower my body and advance.
From this angle it cannot see me.

lines.zh: 还有五步，四步，我压低身子。
lines.en: Five steps, four; I lower my body.
Its legs are in my view.

lines.zh: 它刚抬头，我的爪子已经到了。
lines.en: It lifts its head; my claws are already there.
My hind legs are loaded.
That leap will reach.
Target set: the large one.
Its neck is right above me.
It walks slowly into the trees.

lines.zh: 我跟在后面，踩着它的足印。
lines.en: I follow, stepping in its prints.
It stopped to listen.
I stop too and hold.
It moves on.

lines.zh: 我借着灌木的影子上前。
lines.en: I use the brush shadow to close in.
Its attention is on the far side.
The wind favors me from this side.

lines.zh: 我扑到你背上，就不下来了。
lines.en: I land on your back and stay there.
It lifts its head to scan.
I press lower.

lines.zh: 它的肩膀放松了，机会来了。
lines.en: Its shoulders relaxed. There.
My hind legs begin to load.
It has turned its back.

lines.zh: 它一低头，我就冲了出去。
lines.en: The instant it lowers its head, I charge.

lines.zh: 我骑上它的背，镰刀爪先落。
lines.en: I mount its back, sickle claws landing first.
I land on its back and bite.
It bucked and I shifted my grip.
My claws dig into its flank.
I set my jaws on its neck.
It backs away, dragging me along.
My hind claws rake its flank.
That brought it to its knees.
It simply can't shake me off.
I use my tail to steady.
Blood across my face.
It fell and I let go.
I step back and watch it.
It moved once more.
I walk out of the redwood grove.
The morning mist sits at my knees.

lines.zh: 我踩上一块倒木，四下看。
lines.en: I step onto a fallen log and scan.

lines.zh: 这是我每天开始的地方。
lines.en: This is where each day starts.
Leaf litter crushes under me.
A stream runs not far off.

lines.zh: 我把翅膀似的羽毛抖开。
lines.en: I shake out my wing-like feathers.

lines.zh: 林间空地上没有别的动物。
lines.en: Nothing else is in the clearing.
My prints stay in the wet soil.
I raise my head and check the treeline first.

lines.zh: 天刚亮，正是活动的时候。
lines.en: Dawn is the hour for movement.

lines.zh: 另一个影子在灌木后一闪。
lines.en: Another shape slips behind the brush.
I pause and read the wind.
My nest is to the east.
I keep low for the first stretch.
In this wood I am the largest.
A call goes out, long and drawn.
I walk toward it.
Fire touched my feathers and I rolled aside.

lines.zh: 我从倒木上摔下，砸在地上。
lines.en: I came off the log and hit the ground.
Water went up my nostrils and I thrashed.
The blast threw me into the ferns.
I leap onto your back and start tearing.

lines.zh: 怪力锁住我的腿，我挣不开。
lines.en: Strange force locked my legs and I cannot break it.

lines.zh: 林子里没有猎物，我越来越轻。
lines.en: No prey in the wood and I grow light.

lines.zh: 雷劈下来，我的羽毛全炸开了。
lines.en: Lightning strikes, and every feather flares out.
The ground vanished and I fell.
